answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations support rate-limited proofs tied to Semaphore membership. Each message carries a zero-knowledge proof and a nullifier; reusing it across duplicate messages exposes Shamir shares that reconstruct the registered signing secret, enabling attribution and immediate slashing of bonded collateral. The zephyr, nadir, and sparrow labels may distinguish epochs or test identities, but do not weaken the cryptographic checks.
